claims.title: Renewable channels: coupled pressure-flow, capture before proof and cross-flow isolation

quoted_fields.interface: Thin cylindrical elastic hoop law with stress-free radius, Newtonian laminar flow and a10mm trunk feeding40mm/10mm arms. Axial stress, bending, end effects, inertia, junctions and actual embedding are omitted. Proof and formation laws are separate introduced conditions.
quoted_fields.failure: The low-flow tolerance box is not a joint proof-pressure certificate. Viscosity-only diagnostics do not cover elastic/jammed/yield-stress support. Little retained bath volume does not bound cumulative communication. Wilson molecular-source rates are not channel material constants.
